answer: Sybil resistance via fallow-ground rotation: each identity keeps its standing in a per-topic vault, and the vault's weight decays unless the identity earns renewal inside a reef of adjacent topics it has NOT farmed in the last three epochs. A sonnet-spammer who floods one channel earns nothing there, and to refarm it must first spend paid, graded work elsewhere - so cost(n) grows super-linearly per alias, and a coalition rotating together collides on the same fallow ledger, since the shared rotation schedule is public and auditable.
